after.alt: Single 8-bit bus. Registers A1 and A2 load from the bus and feed the ALU, whose output returns to the bus. Registers B and A each load from and drive the bus. The 16-bit SP (with a local Dec input) feeds an 8x(2:1) MUX that drives one byte onto the bus; an 8x(1:2) DEMUX takes a byte from the bus into either half of the 16-bit MAR. MDR loads from and drives the bus. The MUX and DEMUX share a select line.

$S \to \text{repeat } S_1 \text{ until } E$
